text: Illustrate the story here: Music Class Music class is the best because we get to sing. It is no secret that I love to sing. If you sing well, you get to have a solo. When I have a solo in music class, I pretend I am on a huge stage. It is silent for a moment, then I begin. I sing and sing like time is frozen. At the end, my friends clap for me. That is a nice bonus.
